kps.title: Finding the Matrix Representation of an Affine Transformation Given its Parametric Form
Finding the Parametric Representation of an Affine Transformation Given its Matrix Form

questions.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x = 5u + v - 6, \qquad y = 2u + 4v
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
$$
{\left[ \begin{array}{c}x \\ y\end{array} \right]} = 
{\left[ \begin{array}{cc}5 & \bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{a} \\ \bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{b} & 4\end{array} \right]} \cdot {\left[ \begin{array}{c}u \\ v\end{array} \right]}+
{\left[ \begin{array}{c}- 6 \\ \bbox[2pt,Gainsboro]{c}\end{array} \right]}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x = 3u-v + \bbox[Gainsboro,2pt]{a}, \qquad y = u + \bbox[Gainsboro,2pt]{b}v + \bbox[Gainsboro,2pt]{c}
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
$$
{\left[ \begin{array}{c}x \\ y\end{array} \right]} = 
{\left[ \begin{array}{cc}3 & - 1 \\ 1 & - 5\end{array} \right]} \cdot {\left[ \begin{array}{c}u \\ v\end{array} \right]}+
{\left[ \begin{array}{c}1 \\ 0\end{array} \right]}
$$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

- ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u+v \\ v-u\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}{u}^{2} \\ -v\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u+2 \\ u-v+1\end{bmatrix}$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=u-2v+1,\,y=u+v-2
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}a & b \\ 1 & 1\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ c\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=-u+av+b,\,y=2u-5v+c
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-1 & 4 \\ 2 & -5\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}
$$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

- ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}v-7u+3 \\ 3v-u+1\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}uv+1 \\ u-2v\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}9u \\ u-v\end{bmatrix}$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au+4v,\,y=-5u+bv+c
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-3 & 4 \\ -5 & 3\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=5u+3,\,y=7v-u
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}a & 0 \\ b & 7\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}c \\ 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

- ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u+v \\ \sqrt{v}\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u+1 \\ {v}^{3}\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}3u-2 \\ 8-v\end{bmatrix}$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

- ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}v-6u+7 \\ 4u+3v-5\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}-7u-2v \\ 5u+v\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}2u+v \\ uv+1\end{bmatrix}$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

- ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}7u-v+6 \\ -7\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}8v-9u \\ 4u-v\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u-5 \\ 8u\end{bmatrix}$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

- ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}9u+v \\ 2u+8v\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u \\ 1-{v}^{3}\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u(v-1) \\ u-1\end{bmatrix}$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

- ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}{u}^{2}-{v}^{2} \\ v-u\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}6v-4u \\ 3u+3v\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u+v+9 \\ v-9\end{bmatrix}$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

- ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u-1 \\ {e}^{v}\end{bmatrix}$
- ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}8u+2v+2 \\ u-2v+4\end{bmatrix}$
- $$
\displaystyle {T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u+v \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡(u+v)\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au+bv+3,\,y=-9u+cv+4
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 0 \\ -9 & 4\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au+bv-2,\,y=u+c
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}6 & 8 \\ 1 & 0\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au+v,\,y=bu+cv
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 1 \\ 9 & 3\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=4u+av-2,\,y=bu+cv-3
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}4 & -1 \\ 9 & 5\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -3\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au+6v+b,\,y=cu-4v
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1 & 6 \\ 3 & -4\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au-2v+b,\,y=4u+cv-2
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-6 & -2 \\ 4 & 7\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=4v-u,\,y=3v-7
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}a & b \\ 0 & 3\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}c \\ -7\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=5u-3v-2,\,y=2u+v+7
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}5 & -3 \\ a & b\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}c \\ 7\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=3v-8u,\,y=3u-v
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}a & 3 \\ b & -1\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ c\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=-5v-2,\,y=7v-2u-3
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}0 & a \\ -2 & b\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}c \\ -3\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=6u-v,\,y=2u-3v+4
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}a & -1 \\ 2 & b\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ c\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=6u+4v+2,\,y=5v-1
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}6 & a \\ 0 & b\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ c\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=2u+5v,\,y=u-3v
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 5 \\ a & b\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ c\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=4u+a,\,y=6u+bv+c
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 0 \\ 6 & 2\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ -1\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=v-7u,\,y=2v-u
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}a & 1 \\ -1 & b\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}c \\ 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=8u+av+b,\,y=cv+6
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}8 & 1 \\ 0 & -6\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-5 \\ 6\end{bmatrix}
$$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

I. ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}u(u+1) \\ v+1\end{bmatrix}$

II. ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}v-2 \\ 5u-7\end{bmatrix}$

III. ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}-v \\ -v\end{bmatrix}$

The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=2v+a,\,y=bu+cv
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}x \\ y\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 2 \\ -7 & 4\end{bmatrix}\cdot \begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Which of the following are affine transformations?

I. ${T}_{1}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}uv \\ u+v\end{bmatrix}$

II. ${T}_{2}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}v \\ 2v-u\end{bmatrix}$

III. ${T}_{3}:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v\end{bmatrix}⟶\begin{bmatrix}-{u}^{2} \\ 2u+v\end{bmatrix}$
